speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in it today. I can tell by the boots. Eat before you tell me the title.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two Gentlemen, at two. I am home after. The sheets stay on the board. Nobody is to tidy them into a virtue.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not touch them, sir. The cat will, and the cat does not take orders.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is shrunk on the pan, and it is a penny, and the moon will be full whether you look at it or not. Go when you must.
